model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss over a number of iterations for six distinct model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), SepLLM (n=128), and a sixth configuration represented by an orange line with its legend label obscured by a grey rectangle. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale with a displayed range from 0 to slightly beyond 140000, featuring tick marks spaced every 20000 units. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks evenly spaced at intervals of 0.1. All six data series are plotted as solid lines without distinct marker shapes, and each is surrounded by a lighter, semi-transparent shaded region of the same color. Every line demonstrates a similar overall trend: a sharp initial decline from off-chart values above 3.4 near iteration 0, transitioning into a steady, gradual decrease across the remainder of the x-axis. The solid blue line, corresponding to "StrmLLM (n=64)", maintains the highest trajectory, ending at approximately 2.62 at iteration 140000. Below it, the solid orange line with the obscured label descends to roughly 2.52. The solid green line, denoting "SepLLM (n=64, H)", finishes closely beneath it near 2.51, while the solid dark blue line, corresponding to "SepLLM (n=128)", ends at approximately 2.50. The solid red line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", reaches roughly 2.48 by the end of the axis. Finally, the solid purple line, representing "Vanilla", follows the lowest loss trajectory throughout the plot, concluding at approximately 2.46 at iteration 140000.
